01 · What Is It?

Asia Pub: Game Night

Asia Pub: Game Night is a monthly Warcraft III Dota 1 community event for players in the RGC Asia Public channel.

It is a dedicated period where players can come together, play games, compete with other active players, and have their participation recorded for the event standings and rewards.

02 · When Is It?

Official Event Schedule

Schedule
4th Week of Every Month
The exact event date will be announced in the Asia Public channel.
Official Event Time
19:00 RMT – 23:00 RMT
Only games played during the official event period will be considered.
Important: Watch the Asia Public channel for the official date announcement. The event schedule is based on RMT.
03 · Who Can Join?

Open to All Players

Asia Pub: Game Night is open to players who want to participate during the official event hours.

The Asia Public channel uses an SG Bot system for channel activity, statistics, and event recording. This is simply the bot environment used by the channel.

Players using non-SG bots may still participate. You do not need to be using an SG Bot to join the Game Night.

FYI: Make sure you are in the Asia Public channel and follow the channel's event-related instructions so your participation can be properly verified.
04 · How Does It Work?

Play During the Event. Make Your Games Count.

1
Be present during the official event hours.

Play your Warcraft III Dota 1 games between 19:00 and 23:00 RMT on the announced event date.

2
Play normally.

The event is based on your actual participation and performance during the official Game Night period.

3
Ladder/MMR is not the basis of the event.

Your overall ladder rank or MMR does not determine your Game Night standing. What matters is what you do during the official event.

4
Only verified event games count.

Games must be completed during the official Game Night schedule and must be submitted for verification.

05 · How Will Your Game Be Counted?

Submit These Two Details

After playing a Game Night match, submit the following information so staff can verify and record the game:

Proof 01
Game ID

Provide the Game ID of the match you played during the official Game Night schedule.

Proof 02
Ladder Link

Provide the corresponding ladder/game link so the match can be checked and verified.

That's it. Submit the Game ID and Ladder Link after your game. Staff will handle the verification and recording of eligible matches.
